issues.title: Generated question-structure authority publication is fragile
issues.evidence: Current 18,792-row register is recoverable from Library and identity census is closed, but generated CSV is not versioned on main while YAML points to it.
issues.root_cause: Generated identity-bearing authority not published/versioned with its manifest.

issues.title: V552J→V553 stale handoff consumer seam
issues.evidence: V552J publishes modern typed indexes/manifests; V553 harmonizer still mines legacy handoff packet/provenance conventions.

issues.title: V551J cross-wave semantic diff aligns by wave-sensitive packet_id
issues.evidence: V551J packet_id hashes source_family + canonical_wave + country + family_id + pattern_id; cross-wave diff unions/matches candidate rows by packet_id and labels nonmatches left_only/right_only.
issues.root_cause: An instance identity whose grain includes wave is reused as a wave-independent homology/comparison key.

issues.title: Official CLOSED_35 smoke delegates to active legacy alias substrate
issues.evidence: The public wrapper imports _impl wholesale, patches selected functions and returns _impl.main(). Original resolve_joint_authority, question selection and preflight helpers retain _source_aliases/_wave_aliases and normalized SQL matching.
issues.root_cause: A supposedly superseded implementation remains the execution substrate beneath the governed facade.

issues.title: canonical_wave has incompatible semantics in the live DB substrate and V550
issues.scope: Postgres facet-ready view -> V550 shard scope/prefetch
issues.evidence: apply_postgres_facet_ready_substrate defines canonical_wave as raw r.wave. V550 computes a source-structure canonical wave, then explicitly refuses to rewrite scope_df because querying the DB by that canonical label would return zero rows.
issues.root_cause: One column name is used for both raw source representation and normalized wave representation.

issues.title: Identity resolution is not production-scope authorization
issues.evidence: require_survey_identity canonicalizes recognizable waves without checking CLOSED_35; the planner discovers DB/template cells without loading the frozen 35-wave authority.
issues.root_cause: Syntactic identity resolution and governed membership are conflated by consumers.

issues.title: Literal itinerary identity can silently remove V550 governance gates
issues.evidence: V550 question-list rows expose canonical_wave but no wave field; _select_itinerary falls back to canonical_wave and exact-matches literal itinerary source/wave. EVS 1981 question-list canonical wave is W1 while itinerary key is 1981 with manual_designation_required=true, so current lookup falls back to manual_designation_required=false. EVS 1999/W3 has no itinerary row.
issues.root_cause: An authority gate is keyed by presentation labels rather than stable source/wave identity.

issues.title: Redundant identity fields are precedence-selected rather than coherently validated
issues.scope: shared boundary contract; V551; V550J; V551J; V552; V552J
issues.evidence: Multiple active helpers select the first populated alias/canonical field and exact-match only that representation. Sibling fields such as wave/canonical_wave or source/source_family are not required to agree or resolve to the same governed UID.
issues.root_cause: Alias fields are treated as interchangeable fallback slots instead of distinct representations bound to one machine identity.

issues.title: V550J prepared cache can republish stale identity under a current manifest
issues.scope: prepared response substrate cache -> V550J governed tables -> final consumer verification
issues.evidence: Cache validity signature excludes run/scope identity; reuse preserves existing nonblank identity fields; cache validator does not compare frame identity to manifest; pattern rows inherit prepared source/wave/canonical_wave; V550J manifest is written from current invocation; final consumer verifies manifest identity and table hashes/rows but not table scope values.
issues.root_cause: Cache content identity and producer scope identity are independently trusted without a binding invariant.
